types.name: LoaderProps
types.doc: A family of loaders that share one box, one color and one label. Pick the shape that suits the wait: a spinner for a short action, dots for "someone is working", bars for media, a pulse ring for a live signal, an orbit for longer jobs.

members.name: size
members.doc: Box size: 16 px, 24 px or 40 px.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is loading. Screen readers announce it; it is hidden visually unless `showLabel` is set.

members.name: showLabel
members.doc: Shows the label next to the loader.

members.name: tone
members.doc: "accent" draws in the accent color; "current" inherits the surrounding text color, for loaders inside buttons.

members.name: speed
members.doc: Speed multiplier: 2 runs twice as fast, 0.5 at half speed.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
